title: Isolation of wheat thylakoids for protein analysis
author: Chang, Gou

steps.title: Germinate wheat seeds and grow seedlings
steps.instruction: Spread wheat seeds on germination paper, rinse with tap water overnight, and grow until radicle length equals seed length and germ length reaches half the seed length. Select healthy seeds (~45 mg) and wrap six germinated seeds at one‑third from the top of a 14.9 × 10.5 cm paper piece, place in a glass pot with 3 cm of tap water, and keep in a growth chamber at 25 °C with a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle for one week. Each sample consists of five healthy seedlings at the one‑leaf/one‑hart stage.

steps.title: Prepare chloroplast extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make extraction buffer containing Tricine 20 mM (pH 8.4), D‑sorbitol 300 mM, KCl 10 mM, and EDTA disodium salt dihydrate 10 mM. Store at 4 °C in the dark. Immediately before use, add BSA 0.25 % (m/v), sodium L‑ascorbate 4.5 mM, and L‑cysteine 5 mM.

steps.title: Chill mortar and buffer on ice
steps.instruction: Fill an ice box about three‑quarters full with ice, place a mortar on the ice, and add 10–15 mL of the prepared extraction buffer to keep it cold.

steps.title: Cut leaf discs and grind gently
steps.instruction: Cut wheat leaf tissue into 1 cm pieces, grind gently in the cold extraction buffer until the fibers become white, indicating release of chloroplasts. Perform multiple short grinding rounds with only a few leaf pieces each time to preserve chloroplast integrity.

steps.title: Filter homogenate and collect total protein
steps.instruction: Filter the ground material through Miracloth (Merck‑Millipore, Shanghai, China) into a clean 50 mL centrifuge tube and withdraw 1 mL of the filtrate to store as the total‑protein sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge to obtain soluble protein and pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 1 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C. Remove 1 mL of the supernatant and store as the soluble‑protein sample. Carefully discard the remaining supernatant, keeping the pellet on ice for the next step.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of cold chloroplast extraction buffer to the pellet and keep the suspension on ice.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose gradient for chloroplast purification
steps.instruction: Prepare two sucrose solutions in the extraction buffer: 30 % (m/v) sucrose and 52 % (m/v) sucrose.

steps.title: Layer gradient and load sample
steps.instruction: In a clean 15 mL centrifuge tube, gently add 4 mL of the 52 % sucrose solution followed by 4 mL of the 30 % sucrose solution along the tube wall. Tap the tube gently to resuspend the pellet and carefully place the sample on top of the gradient.

steps.title: Centrifuge gradient and collect chloroplasts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the gradient at 5 000 g for 30 min at 4 °C. Collect the intact chloroplast band located between the 30 % and 52 % sucrose layers into a clean 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Wash chloroplasts three times
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of cold chloroplast washing buffer (HEPES 20 mM, pH 7.8; D‑sorbitol 300 mM; KCl 10 mM; EDTA 2.5 mM; MgCl₂·6H₂O 5 mM) to the chloroplast suspension, mix gently, then centrifuge at 5 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant. Repeat the addition, mixing, centrifugation, and discard steps two more times (total of three washes).

steps.title: Aliquot chloroplast protein sample
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 3 mL of chloroplast washing buffer, keep on ice, and store 300 µL of this suspension as the chloroplast‑protein aliquot.

steps.title: Shock chloroplasts with Na4P2O7 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of cold chloroplast shocking buffer (10 mM Na₄P₂O₇, pH 7.8) to the suspension, mix gently, and keep on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Disrupt chloroplasts by syringe passage (first)
steps.instruction: Pass the shocked suspension through a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 24‑gauge needle 50 times to break the chloroplasts thoroughly.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect pellet (first)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the disrupted suspension at 7 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and retain the pellet.

steps.title: Repeat disruption and centrifugation (second)
steps.instruction: Pass the pellet again through a 1 mL syringe with a 24‑gauge needle 50 times, then centrifuge at 7 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and keep the resulting pellet.

steps.title: Wash thylakoids with buffer I and homogenize
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL thylakoid washing buffer I (Tricine 2 mM, pH 7.8; sucrose 300 mM), pass through a 1 mL syringe with a 24‑gauge needle 20 times, centrifuge at 4 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and keep the pellet.

steps.title: Wash thylakoids with buffer II and homogenize
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL thylakoid washing buffer II (30 mM NaH₂PO₄, pH 7.8; MgCl₂·6H₂O 5 mM; NaCl 50 mM; sucrose 100 mM; EDTA 1 mM), pass through a 1 mL syringe with a 24‑gauge needle 20 times, centrifuge at 4 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and retain the pellet.

steps.title: Final resuspension, normalize, and store
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 100 µL thylakoid washing buffer II, normalize the suspension based on chlorophyll concentration, aliquot as needed, and store at –80 °C.
